headline: Candour Techtex issues 2.66 lakh shares from warrants
hook: Equity base expands via warrant conversion
summary: Candour Techtex Limited has allotted 2,66,666 equity shares following the conversion of convertible warrants. This action increases the company's total outstanding equity base. Such conversions are standard corporate actions that adjust the capital structure of the firm.
why_it_matters: Minor equity dilution for existing shareholders.
